guidelines.title: Manuscript Writing Guidelines & Format
guidelines.description: Guidelines on typesetting, chapter structure, citation style, and scholarly integrity standards for monograph and textbook submissions.

items.label: Paper Size:
items.value: UNESCO B5 (15.5 x 23 cm) or standard A4.

items.label: Margins:
items.value: Left 3.0 cm, Right 2.5 cm, Top 2.5 cm, Bottom 2.5 cm.

items.label: Typeface:
items.value: Times New Roman or Palatino Linotype, 12 pt.

items.label: Spacing & Indent:
items.value: 1.5 line spacing, first-line indent of 1.27 cm.

items.label: Length:
items.value: At least 150 pages for a scholarly monograph.

items.label: Required Software:
items.value: Mendeley, Zotero, or EndNote for consistent metadata.

items.label: References:
items.value: At least 80% of references drawn from reputable journals published in the last 10 years.

items.label: Front Matter:
items.value: Inner Title Page, Copyright Page, Preface, Table of Contents, List of Tables & Figures.

items.label: Body:
items.value: Chapter I (Introduction & Research Context), Theoretical Review, Discussion & Critical Analysis, Conclusions & Policy Directions.

items.label: Back Matter:
items.value: Glossary of Key Terms, Complete Bibliography, Subject/Name Index, Brief Author Biography.

plagiarism.title: 4. Anti-Plagiarism Policy & Turnitin
plagiarism.thresholdDescription: Manuscripts must have a similarity index of no more than 20% using the official Turnitin filters: Exclude Bibliography On and Exclude Matches < 3 Words.
plagiarism.note: Manuscripts must be free from fabricated research data, falsified findings, and self-plagiarism without proper citation of prior works.

cta.title: Does Your Manuscript Meet the Guidelines?

process.title: The 5-Stage Publishing Process
process.description: Transparent, measurable, held to high academic standards, and supported by a professional editorial team.

steps.title: Submission & Peer Review
steps.description: Authors submit the full draft and synopsis through our official portal. Our in-house team carries out administrative verification and a Turnitin plagiarism check, followed by a substantive review by our Peer Reviewers to ensure scholarly rigor.

steps.title: Contract & Intellectual Property
steps.description: Signing of the official Book Publishing Agreement between the author and PT Cakrawala Magna Scientia. Selection of a royalty scheme (10–15%) or institutional grant, and filing for a Copyright Registration Certificate through e-Hak Cipta at DJKI, Ministry of Law and Human Rights.
deliverables: Protection of the Author's Moral Rights

steps.title: Editorial & Layout
steps.description: Expert editors copyedit to standard Indonesian (PUEBI), verify legal and tax terminology, and typeset the book to the UNESCO B5 standard. Our design team creates an authoritative 3D editorial cover.

steps.title: ISBN & Metadata Registration
steps.description: Application for an official ISBN and EAN barcode from the National Library of Indonesia (Perpusnas), together with registration of CIP Data and national metadata as proof of the work's standing as legitimate, accredited scholarship.

steps.title: Printing & Digital Distribution
steps.description: Physical production on premium 72 gsm book paper with deluxe matte hardcover/softcover binding. Two legal deposit copies are submitted to Perpusnas in accordance with Law No. 13 of 2018, followed by the national distribution launch.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about ISBNs, royalties, publishing timelines, and copyright for scholarly works.

items.question: Do all books published by CakraNexa receive an official ISBN from the National Library of Indonesia (Perpusnas)?
items.answer: Yes. As an official publisher, a member of the Indonesian Publishers Association (IKAPI), and registered with the National Library of the Republic of Indonesia, every title that passes our editorial feasibility review is published with an official ISBN and EAN barcode. Each book's bibliographic data is also registered as CIP Data with Perpusnas.

items.question: How long does it take from manuscript submission to publication?
items.answer: Standard publication takes 14 to 30 business days once the manuscript has been declared complete and approved. This covers substantive peer review (7–14 days), copyediting and B5 layout (5–7 days), official ISBN registration with Perpusnas (3–7 business days), followed by print production and digital cataloguing.

items.question: How do royalties and copyright work for authors?
items.answer: Copyright and moral rights in the scholarly work remain entirely with the author. Royalties of 10% to 15% of the net sale price are paid transparently, with reports every semester. For institutions and corporations, an outright purchase publishing scheme is also available under a written agreement.

items.question: Does CakraNexa publish books adapted from master's theses or doctoral dissertations?
items.answer: Yes. We guide the conversion of dissertations and theses into monographs that earn DIKTI credit points (KUM BKD). Our "Book Doctors" team and specialist editors help restructure rigid report-style writing into a flowing, engaging scholarly monograph of high academic merit.

items.question: What is the minimum print run I can order?
items.answer: We use modern Print-on-Demand (POD) technology, so authors can print as few as 10 copies for limited needs (such as professorial inaugurations, doctoral promotions, or study program accreditation). We also handle large print runs of thousands of copies on professional offset presses.

items.question: How are published books distributed and marketed?
items.answer: Books are distributed through the official CakraNexa Store portal, official online marketplace stores, university library catalogues, and our network of partner bookstores throughout Indonesia. We also distribute DRM-protected digital e-book editions to readers worldwide.
